hook_text: Start your scale at 30 and 70 cans looks eight times bigger than 35. Here is how to keep a graph honest.
clip_script: Recycling race in Durban! Grade 6A against 6B. Pictograph first: one can picture is 10 cans. 35 cans? Three and a half pictures! Now a bar graph: start at 0, equal steps of 10, same-width bars. Then the double bar graph: two bars side by side every month, with a legend. April: 6B's bar towers over 6A's, 50 to 35! Keep it honest: key, scale, legend.
visual_style: Cans stacking into pictograph rows, then morphing into coloured bars rising against a clean scale.
mood: Competitive and fun, like a school sports scoreboard.
pacing: Quick pictograph build, steady bars rising, then a side-by-side reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw a double bar graph of your family's favourite foods.
